subject: Ciências da Natureza e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Realizar previsões, avaliar intervenções e/ou construir protótipos de sistemas térmicos que visem à sustentabilidade, considerando sua composição e os efeitos das variáveis termodinâmicas sobre seu funcionamento, considerando também o uso de tecnologias digitais que auxiliem no cálculo de estimativas e no apoio à construção dos protótipos.

components.description_pt: Identificar variáveis termodinâmicas que afetam o funcionamento de sistemas térmicos
components.description_en: Identify thermodynamic variables that affect the operation of thermal systems
components.cc_component_description: Identify variables including mass, material type, and energy input that affect average kinetic energy of particles

components.description_pt: Avaliar sustentabilidade de sistema térmico baseando-se em sua composição e comportamento energético
components.description_en: Evaluate the sustainability of a thermal system based on its composition and energy behavior
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate a technological solution based on its potential to minimize waste and ecosystem degradation

components.description_pt: Construir protótipo de sistema térmico voltado ao uso sustentável de energia
components.description_en: Construct a prototype of a thermal system aimed at sustainable energy use
components.cc_component_description: Apply scientific principles of thermal energy transfer to design a device that minimizes or maximizes heat flow

components.description_pt: Usar tecnologias digitais para estimar cálculos termodinâmicos no projeto de sistemas
components.description_en: Use digital technologies to estimate thermodynamic calculations in system design
components.cc_component_description: Use digital simulations or calculations to compare the performance of competing design solutions

components.description_pt: Fazer previsões sobre o comportamento de sistema térmico sob condições variáveis
components.description_en: Make predictions about the behavior of a thermal system under varying conditions
components.cc_component_description: Use a model to predict the behavior of a phenomenon under specified conditions

cc_matches.description: Scientists and engineers can make major contributions by developing technologies that produce less pollution and waste and that preclude ecosystem degradation.

Plan an investigation to determine the relationships among the energy transferred, the type of matter, the mass, and the change in the average kinetic energy of the particles as measured by the temperature of the sample.
Apply scientific principles to design, construct, and test a device that either minimizes or maximizes thermal energy transfer.
Use digital tools and/or mathematical concepts and arguments to test and compare proposed solutions to an engineering design problem.
